summary: A QLoRA fine-tune (Unsloth, 4-bit) of Qwen3-8B on about a thousand private exam-style question and answer pairs, run on one card in three rounds and evaluated on held-out questions, with a GGUF export served by llama.cpp as a demo. Round one taught the answer-key style but also taught the model to invent answers where a document was missing; oversampling abstention examples did not fix it; relabelling the contradictory training items so that they state what is missing did, raising abstention with almost no over-refusal. Recipe, training figures and aggregate scores per checkpoint only (data/forge/); the lab kept no full loss curve; the corpus, the adapters and the answers stay private.
title: Fine-tuning rounds: an exam-style tutor on Qwen3-8B
